# myQode

> myQode is the client portal and app of Qode Advisors LLP, a SEBI registered portfolio manager based in Mumbai. Clients sign in to see their portfolio management service (PMS) accounts.

Everything after sign-in is private client data and must not be crawled or summarised. The public pages are listed below.

## Public pages

- [Sign in](https://myqode.qodeinvest.com/login): sign-in for Qode clients and partners
- [Contact us](https://myqode.qodeinvest.com/contactus): Investor Relations phone, email and office address
- [Privacy policy](https://myqode.qodeinvest.com/privacypolicy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://myqode.qodeinvest.com/termsandcondition)
- [Cancellation and refund policy](https://myqode.qodeinvest.com/cancellation)

## Contact
